nodes.name: armors.json
nodes.summary: Defines 172 armor sets for Voxel Blade. Each set has a name, shared stats (defense, elemental boosts, resistance), a unique perk with amount, and part descriptions (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings). Stats include physical/magic defense, elemental boosts (fire, water, earth, air, holy, hex), dexterity, summon boost, protection, warding, tenacity, jump/speed/attack speed boosts, and heat/cold resistance.
nodes.languageNotes: Large JSON array (174 lines, ~172 armor entries). Each entry follows a consistent schema: {name, sharedPart: {upgrade, stats, perkName, perkAmount}, parts: [{type, description}]}. Some armors have incomplete perk references (empty perkName).

nodes.name: blades.json
nodes.summary: Defines 106 blade items (weapon heads) organized by tiers 1-5. Each blade has a name, tier, attack speed, damage type stats (physical, elemental scalings and boosts), optional perks, and a blade type (Small Blade, Medium Blade, Heavy Blade, Hammer Head). Tiers range from Basic (tier 1) to Starlight (tier 5).
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 107 lines containing 106 blade entries. Schema: {name, tier, attackSpeed, stats: {typeValues, scalings, boosts}, perks: [{name, amount}], bladeType}. Damage types include physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, holy, hex, true.

nodes.name: enchantments.json
nodes.summary: Defines 51 enchantments split into two categories: 'unAscended' (26 base enchantments) and 'Ascended' (25 advanced enchantments). Each has a stacking rule (exclusive or multi), stat modifiers (multipliers/additions), optional effects with named abilities, and optional additional notes about acquisition conditions.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 52 lines. Schema: {name, category, stacking, stats: {statName: {type, value}}, effects: [{name, value}], additionalNotes}. Stat types are 'multiplier' or 'addition'. Some stats are compound (e.g., positiveStats, negativeStats).

nodes.name: essences.json
nodes.summary: Defines 105 essence items organized by tiers 1-5. Essences are stat-modifying components that mirror blade designs. Each has a name, tier, attack speed, scaling stats, optional perks, and an essenceType (typically 'Essence', one 'Proto Essence'). Tiers range from Basic (tier 1) to Starlight (tier 5).
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 107 lines containing 105 entries. Schema: {name, tier, attackSpeed, stats: {scalings, boosts}, perks: [{name, amount}], essenceType}. Many essences share names or close variants with blades and handles.

nodes.name: gloves.json
nodes.summary: Defines 22 glove items organized by tiers 1-4. Each glove has a name, tier, attack speed, damage type stats, perks (including unique Spirit perks for the Monk guild), and a gloveType (Gloves or Shield). Gloves are the Monk-class weapon type and always include a Spirit perk.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 24 lines containing 22 entries. Schema: {name, tier, attackSpeed, stats, perks: [{name, amount}], gloveType}. Each glove includes a creature-specific Spirit perk (e.g., 'Buni Spirit', 'Bumblz Spirit').

nodes.name: guilds.json
nodes.summary: Defines 9 character guilds, each with 3 ranks. Guilds provide stat bonuses and perks that scale with rank. Guilds include Gladiator, Cursed, Cleric, Scholar, Knight, Thief, Draconic, Monk, and Vampire. Each rank increases stat values and perk amounts.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 56 lines containing 9 guilds. Schema: {name, ranks: [{rank: 1-3, stats: {...}, perks: [{name, amount}]}]}. Guilds reference perks from perks.json. Monk guild is required for glove Spirit perks.

nodes.name: handles.json
nodes.summary: Defines 103 handle items (weapon shafts) organized by tiers 1-5. Each handle has a name, tier, attack speed, scaling stats, optional perks, and a handleType (Medium Handle, Long Handle, or Pole). Tiers range from Basic (tier 1) to Starlight (tier 5). Many handles are paired with corresponding blades.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 105 lines containing 103 entries. Schema: {name, tier, attackSpeed, stats: {scalings, boosts}, perks: [{name, amount}], handleType}. Handle types include Medium Handle, Long Handle, and Pole variants.

nodes.name: perks.json
nodes.summary: Defines 247+ unique perks (combat abilities and passive effects) with detailed descriptions and tag classifications. Tags categorize perks by source (Armor, Weapon, Ring, Guild, Enchantment), function (Offensive, Defensive, Buff, Debuff, Healing, etc.), and mechanics (RNG, Cooldown Reduction, Poison/Burn/Bleed Potency, etc.). This is the central reference file for all perk names used across equipment.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 3687 lines containing 247+ perk entries. Schema: {name, description, tags: [string]}. This is the largest data file in the project. Perks reference each other and are referenced by all equipment files.

nodes.name: races.json
nodes.summary: Defines 10 playable races with unique passive abilities and stat modifiers. Races include Human, Half-Ork, Elf, Dark Elf, Dragon Blooded, Ork, High Elf, Arborian, Kitsune, and Bunikin. Each has a passive description and optional numeric stat/cooldown modifiers.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 12 lines containing 10 entries. Schema: {name, passive, statModifiers?, cooldownModifiers?, globalArmorPenetration?, waArmorPenetration?}. Simple structure with optional modifier objects.

nodes.name: rings.json
nodes.summary: Defines 35 ring accessories, each providing stat boosts and a unique perk. Rings are equipment accessories that enhance specific playstyles. Each has a name, description, upgrade level, stat boosts, and a named perk with amount.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 37 lines containing 35 entries. Schema: {name, description, upgrade, stats: {...}, perkName, perkAmount}. Simple structure with fixed upgrade value of 0.

nodes.name: runes.json
nodes.summary: Defines 41 rune abilities (active skills) with stat boosts, cooldowns, and optional perk grants. Runes are activatable abilities with cooldowns ranging from 5 to 120 seconds. Each has a name, description, upgrade level, stat boosts, cooldown, and optional linked perk.
nodes.languageNotes: JSON array with 43 lines containing 41 entries. Schema: {name, description, upgrade, stats: {...}, cooldown, perkName?, perkAmount?}. Simple structure with fixed upgrade value of 0.

nodes.name: ONBOARDING.md

nodes.name: CdrStepsCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Small component (93 lines) displaying cooldown reduction calculation steps as a visual chain showing each multiplier step, floor operation, and minimum CD cap.

nodes.name: Boost.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all damage/heal boost calculations (454 lines). Covers perks like Frenzy, Vampire, Spirit Winds, Primal, Queens Power, Penance, etc.

nodes.name: cdr.ts

nodes.languageNotes: 63 lines; imports from lib/constants; exports CDR_PERK_DATA and PerkCDREntry interface.

nodes.name: debuffCombatEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Defines combat effects of debuffs (98 lines): Weakness (damage reduction), Shatter/Electrical Rend (armor loss), Sticky variants (movement slow + type damage taken increase), Despair (increased damage dealt), Frostbite (elemental vulnerability), Hypnotized (magic armor loss).
nodes.languageNotes: 98 lines; exports DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS record and DebuffCombatEffect interface.

nodes.name: defensivePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defensive perk damage reduction calculations (206 lines). Exports getActiveDefensivePerkSources and calcDefensivePotencyMult.

nodes.name: DoTDamage.ts

nodes.languageNotes: 74 lines; exports DotType, DOT_SCALINGS, DOT_DMG_TYPE_MAP, and 4 functions.

nodes.name: draconicBuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic guild buff system (111 lines). Functions for Dragon Infusion potency/duration multipliers, Dragon Infusion buff generation (with color-specific effects for fire/hex/holy/water/air/earth), and Dragon Claw/Bubble ability debuff generation.
nodes.languageNotes: 111 lines; imports from lib/constants and BuffData; exports 5 functions.

nodes.name: draconicColorEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic color attack stat definitions (49 lines). Defines DraconicColorAttackStats for 6 colors (fire/air/earth/water/holy/hex) with damage multipliers, speed multipliers, knockback, cooldown, stun, and special effects (burn, weakness, heals).
nodes.languageNotes: 49 lines; exports DRACONIC_COLOR_ATTACK_STATS array, DraconicColorAttackStats interface, getDraconicColorDmgMultiplier function.

nodes.name: draconicRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic rune and infusion bonus calculations (104 lines). Functions to apply dragon rune damage type bonuses (5% per stack of draconic color) and dragon infusion damage type bonuses (based on buff potency). Exports applyDraconicBonuses and getDraconicBonuses.
nodes.languageNotes: 104 lines; exports 2 public functions and 2 context interfaces.

nodes.summary: Enemy HP-gated effects (90 lines). Defines perks that trigger based on enemy HP thresholds (e.g., Mycotic Bloom: Slowness above 50% HP, Poison damage boost below 50% HP). Exports getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs and getEnemyHpDotMultiplier.
nodes.languageNotes: 90 lines; no external imports; exports 2 functions.

nodes.name: HealBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Healing boost calculation system (217 lines). nodes.languageNotes: 217 lines; imports from lib/constants and draconicBuffs; exports HealSource, HealBoostContext, calculateHealBoost.

nodes.name: mountRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Mount rune definitions (88 lines). Defines MountRuneDef interface and MOUNT_RUNE_DEFS array for 3 mounts (Winter Woof, Slizard, Glacial Snapper) with M1 attack and Weapon Art stats (base damage, damage types, scalings, cooldowns, guardbreak, secondary effects).

nodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates automatic debuffs that perks inflict on enemies. Contains logic for ~20 perks (Penance, Melting Shred, Fungal Prototype, Venom Spitter, Toxin Caster, Gorecast, Splinter, Vicious Edge, Caci Spirit, Woof Spirit, Gravitational Enforcer, Ice Burst, Bellowing Ember, Frostbite, Gelid Lance, Weakening, Sunburn, Fiery Pursuit, Pyre Bloom, Runic Blades, Hypnotist, Cryo Engine). Also delegates to enemyHpEffects for enemy-HP-gated debuffs.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports AutoDebuffInput interface, calcActualHpFillPct, and getAutoDebuffs functions.

nodes.name: potions.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Potion interface and a static list of potions (Rage Potion, Poison Potion) with their descriptions and colors. Exports a POTIONS array and POTION_MAP lookup.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports Potion interface, POTIONS array, and POTION_MAP record.

nodes.name: procCoefficients.ts
nodes.summary: Lookup tables for M1/M2 proc coefficients per weapon type and weapon art proc coefficients. Covers ~30 weapon types (Fists, Chain Fists, various swords, daggers, spears, mallets, kamas, scythes, lances, chainsaws, shields, magic weapons, guns) and 5 weapon arts (Lunge, Spin, Rapid Stab, Slam, Laser). Provides DEFAULT_PROC_COEFF fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports WEAPON_PROC_COEFFS, WA_PROC_COEFFS records and DEFAULT_PROC_COEFF constant.

nodes.name: raceEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Defines race-conditional effects based on HP gates (e.g., HUMAN gets 1.2x dmg and 20% DR below 50% HP). Also provides Ork Tenacity helpers that filter non-debuff buffs and calculate bonus from buff count.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports RaceConditionalEffect interface, getActiveRaceEffect, getOrkTenacityBuffs, and calcOrkTenacityBonus functions.

nodes.name: Runebasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Defines rune-based damage definitions (RUNE_DMG_DEFS array) for ~16 runes: Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, Fireball, Rocky Tail, False Sun, Snoeball, Rage, Weakening Roar. nodes.name: selfDamagePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines self-damage perk definitions (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier, Steam Powered) with their damage types, DR per stack, proc chances, and flat damage values. Provides calcSelfDamage function that computes damage taken by the player including multi-target falloff and defense multipliers.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports SelfDamagePerkDef interface, SELF_DAMAGE_PERK_DEFS array, and calcSelfDamage function.

nodes.name: stanceOverlays.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon stance overlays that change the M2 attack type based on equipped perks and weapon. Handles Mine, Cosmic Ray, Blaster Ring (Fists/Weapon), and Locked And Loaded (Fists/Weapon) overlays.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports StanceOverlayResult, StanceOverlayCtx interfaces and resolveStanceOverlay function.

nodes.name: statboost.ts
nodes.summary: Applies stat-modifying perks in a defined execution order via PERK_REGISTRY. Handles 16 perks: Roaring Heads, Lucky, Quick Witted, Whirl Foot, Carapace, Extra Layers, Frozen Heart, Immovable, Righted Wrongs, Rocky Body, Spellshield, Strong Tides, Swift Guard, True Balance, Brawny, Weight Distribution. nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports OFFENSIVE_BOOSTS array and applyStatBoostPerks function. Uses a PerkHandler type and ordered PERK_REGISTRY.

nodes.name: SummonData.ts

nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript. Exports calcSummonStat, calcMaxSummonCount functions, SUMMON_MAP, WA_SUMMON_MAP constants.

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts

layers.name: Infrastructure & Configuration
layers.description: Build tooling, project configuration, CI/CD pipeline, documentation, and application entry point. Defines how the project is built, deployed, and initialized.

layers.name: Game Data Definitions
layers.description: Raw game data as JSON (weapons, armor, perks, enchantments, races, etc.) and TypeScript modules that process, augment, or compute derived values from that data (buffs, debuffs, damage boosts, proc coefficients, etc.). This is the domain's data layer.

layers.name: Constants & Type System
layers.description: Game-wide constants (buffs, boosts, damage types, perks, CDR, thresholds, draconic properties, stat conversions) and shared TypeScript type definitions. Provides the vocabulary and constraints that all higher layers reference.

layers.name: Calculation Engine
layers.description: Core damage calculation engine. Processes builds, weapons, enchantments, and shrine bonuses to compute final damage numbers. Consumes game data and constants to produce derived calculations.

layers.name: State Management
layers.description: Application-level reactive state. Central store holding the current build configuration, user selections, and cross-component synchronization. Also includes auxiliary stores like toast notifications.

layers.name: Shared Services & Utilities
layers.description: Cross-cutting utility functions, stat processing, crit/defense calculations, damage type resolution, enchantment tooltips, and filter actions. Bridges the engine and state layers to the UI.

layers.name: UI Components & Presentation
layers.description: All Svelte components: page-level views (App, DamageAnalyzer, BaseDamageCalc, BuffList, BuildSaves), reusable primitives (Badge, Button, RollValue), modal dialogs (AccessorySelect, Guild, Race, WeaponPart), shared UI fragments (AppHeader, EnchantSelect, StatFilterShared, Toast), and styling.

tour.title: App Entry & Bootstrap
tour.description: The application bootstraps from src/main.ts, a 7-line entry point that imports the global stylesheet and mounts the root Svelte component to #app while injecting Vercel analytics. App.svelte is the ~4431-line monolithic root component orchestrating the entire UI—equipment slots, enchantment selection, weapon arts, drag-and-drop, and summary displays. app.css provides the design tokens (colors, spacing, shadows, typography) that every component consumes. This step gives you the big picture before diving into the engine.

tour.title: Type System & Game Data
tour.description: types.ts defines the central domain contracts—StatMap, BuildState, enchantments, weapon blades/handles, monk gloves/essences—and derives the stat-key taxonomy using keyof/typeof and template-literal types. It also exports small helpers like applyUpgrade (scaling stats by equipment level) and canProc (proc-coefficient check) used across the engine. engine/data.ts is the barrel re-exporting the typed data accessors built on these contracts. Understanding these types is essential before reading the calculation pipeline.

tour.title: State Management (The Store)
tour.description: store.ts is the single source of truth for the player build. It exposes a Svelte writable store with debounced localStorage persistence, a derived damage result, and mutation helpers (setEnchantment, setGuild, moveArmorSlot, swapEnchantments) that every UI flow calls. The derived result store is what powers every damage display in the app. setGuild even swaps weapons, gloves, and essences automatically when you switch to the Draconic or Monk guilds.

tour.title: JSON Game Data & Lookup Functions
tour.description: The engine/data/ directory loads and indexes game items from the JSON catalogs in src/data/—races, guilds, perks, armors, rings, runes, enchantments, blades, handles, gloves, and essences—exposing typed getters (getRace, getArmorPart, getEnchant, getBlade, getGlove). perks.json is the most depended-on file in the graph (fan-in 9), because every equipment catalog references its 247+ perk definitions. enchantments.json models 51 enchants split into unAscended/Ascended tiers with stacking rules and stat modifiers.

tour.title: Weapon Calculation
tour.description: weapon.ts resolves the final weapon type from blade+handle combinations (including perk overrides like Dual Wielding), merges part scalings and stats, detects hybrid weapons, and handles the monk glove/essence path with rank-based bonuses. shrine.ts applies tier-based shrine multipliers (tier 1 = 3x down to tier 5 = 1x) to both stats and scalings. The resulting WeaponResult feeds every downstream damage formula.

tour.title: Enchantment System
tour.description: enchant.ts applies enchantment modifiers to equipment slots in two phases—selector transforms first, then direct stat/perk modifiers—and enforces exclusive vs. stacked slot rules via enforceEnchantSlot. Infusion halves all stats while copying perks, and perk effectiveness scales by (1 + 0.1*stacks). _utils.ts supplies the round2/round4 helpers with epsilon compensation that keep every engine calculation numerically consistent.

tour.title: Core Damage Calculation Engine
tour.description: build.ts is the heart of the application: calcBuild() runs accumulateEquipment → finalizePerks → deriveResults to turn a BuildState into a full BuildResult. It orchestrates data lookup, enchantment application, shrine multipliers, cooldown reduction (calcCDR), boost multipliers (calcBoosts), buff assembly (computeBuffs), and damage-type bonuses. Its 21 outgoing edges make it the second-largest hub after BuffData.ts, tying the entire engine together.
tour.languageLesson: build.ts is composed as a layered pipeline of pure functions (accumulateEquipment, finalizePerks, deriveResults) that are called sequentially, keeping each stage independently testable and reusable.

tour.title: Constants, Buffs & Perk Definitions
tour.description: constants/index.ts is the wildcard barrel aggregating every hardcoded game value—damage-type colors and priorities, crit thresholds, CDR, defensive values, draconic multipliers, and perk base damages. buffs.ts holds 160+ buff/debuff potency constants, while BuffData.ts (the highest fan-out node at 38 edges) assembles and modifies the active buff set from perks, potions, and weapon arts. statboost.ts applies stat-conversion perks (Weight Distribution, Quick Witted, Carapace) in a strict registry order.

tour.title: UI Components & Shared Primitives
tour.description: DamageAnalyzer.svelte is the largest component in the project (8k+ lines), managing build state and feeding BaseDamageCalc through an ~80-prop interface to compute per-hit and per-tick damage. BuffList renders the assembled active buff set, and WeaponStatsDisplay presents weapon stats as colored pills split into damage types, scalings, and boosts. Shared primitives like Badge, Button, and RollValue are the reusable building blocks every modal and panel relies on.

tour.title: Build Saves, Controls & Polish
tour.description: BuildSaves.svelte (~1360 lines) handles localStorage save slots, base64 import/export, fuzzy search, and drag-and-drop reordering. CdrStepsCalc visualizes each cooldown-reduction step as a chain, while EmotionalTracker and the other trackers expose game-specific toggles that write into the build store. StatFilter and WeaponStatFilter provide tri-state include/exclude filtering for the equipment modals, and AppHeader ties save management and the Overview/Analyze tabs together.

tour.title: Documentation & Deployment
tour.description: ONBOARDING.md is a complete architecture guide—layers, key concepts, and a guided tour—that confirms the structure you have just walked through. On the delivery side, vite.config.ts wires the Svelte build plus PWA/service-worker support, package.json defines the dev/build/check/test scripts, and vercel.json or the GitHub Pages workflow (static.yml) publish the static output. These stops show how the calculator goes from source to a deployed, installable web app.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows use 'on' triggers, 'jobs' for parallel work, and 'steps' for sequential commands; here a build job compiles the Vite app and uploads the dist artifact, then a deploy job publishes it to Pages.
